title: ArtifactVersion
description: One immutable, hash-checked, owner-scoped version in the artifact store (ADR-0018, FR-MEM-12; PRD 13.2, 15.1): the metadata record at orgs/{org}/worlds/{world}/artifacts/{artifact_id}/versions/{version:06d}. The bytes live under a key derived from the ids, so the record holds no blob path. Read by the harness, tilo-api, tilo-render and erasure; only the store writes it. Rules the schema cannot express are AR-01 to AR-08 in artifact.rules.md.

size_bytes.description: Stored size: at least 1 byte, at most 50,000,000 for a file and 2,000,000 for text or JSON (BQ-257, AR-04).

content_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the stored bytes, lower-case hex; every read recomputes it (AR-01).

parents.description: The earlier version of the same artifact this one continues, or the version a restore copies (AR-02); empty for version 1.

sources.description: Raw-archive pointers of the version's sources, for the Verifier (FR-CON-10, FR-AGT-12): records of the record's own run for a unit or render output, the copied version's for a restore, none for an upload (AR-03). They never leave Tilo (AR-06).

screening.description: The SafetyProvider verdict on the exact stored bytes (PRD 16.3 item 2), unscreened when there is none. A version that is not clean raises safety_flag in the policy engine (AR-07).

screened_at.description: When that verdict came back; null exactly when screening is unscreened (AR-07).

redacted.description: true when the secret redactor changed text or JSON before it was stored (SEC-01, BQ-258). The redactor reads only text and JSON, so false on a file means it did not run (AR-07).

idempotency_key.description: Set for unit and render outputs (AR-05); null for uploads and restores.

then.description: A model writes only text and JSON, never a file (ADR-0018 1).

media_type.description: Text and JSON are at most 2,000,000 bytes (BQ-257). Keyed by a required field, so it always applies; the root keeps one if/then/else.

screening.description: clean and flagged carry the verdict's time; unscreened has none (AR-07).

origin.description: What made the version: a unit's runner (unit and the worker agent set), tilo-render (for a unit), an intake upload (neither) or a restore (FR-MEM-06; no unit). Set by the store from the run, never by a runner.

source.description: Where one source's text is in the raw archive: id is the manifest source id, archive_ref the tool call record. A pointer, never content.

idempotency_key.description: <run_id>:<unit_id>:<attempt>:<index> (AR-05). index is the output's 0-based position, 0 to 9, since a unit has at most 10 outputs (BQ-257).

manifest_revision.description: One append-only revision of a version's provenance manifest, at .../versions/{version:06d}/manifests/{n:04d} (AR-06): created at put, reviewed after the Verifier (cause its artifact.reviewed), sent (cause the data.transfer out) or exported when the version leaves Tilo. Readers take the highest n.
